name: Gestures_Confused_1
short_caption: The robot slightly rotates its head and moves its hands outward in a subtle gesture of confusion or hesitation.
movement_description: The robot starts in a neutral posture and begins by slightly tilting and rotating its head to the right. Simultaneously, it lifts both hands slightly forward and outward, opening its palms while keeping its elbows close to its body. After a brief pause in this pose to convey uncertainty, the robot smoothly returns its head and arms back to the neutral starting position.
safety_notes: The arms move close to the body within the standard interactive volume.
